scope: Selected variants only; no whole-suite coverage claim. Each supported variant runs in an isolated native process. Synchronous and Promise-job asynchronous Scripts use parsed strictness and unchanged harness sources. Parse/early-negative tests use native syntax validation without evaluation. Unsupported module execution, agents, lowering and runtime operations, as well as harness errors, crashes and timeouts remain in the totals.
variantPolicy: All syntaxVariants from tools/test262.ts; raw/strict/sloppy/module flags retained; fixture files excluded. No unsupported or failed variants excluded from the denominator.

compilation.failurePolicy: A failed batch compilation is retained for every affected variant; no automatic retry.
